li.label: the lost letters got home
li.description: Letters that lay by the road for years finally reached the people they were for, because we sent them on.

li.label: the stranger's garden
li.description: We grew a plant from a stranger's seeds, the last of its kind, and it's thriving here. Something saved.

li.label: my field is choked
li.description: The stranger's plant has taken over my field, runners and all. I should have pulled it up when I could.

li.label: saw the play about us
li.description: A troupe played our own story to us in the yard. It was strange, watching someone pretend to be us, and I liked it.

li.label: they put us on the stage
li.description: There's a play about our colony, and it's a hit. Strangers on the road know our names.
